info.about: Drill Dozer is a platformer video game developed by Game Freak and published by Nintendo for the Game Boy Advance (GBA). Directed by Ken Sugimori, the game stars Jill and her mech Drill Dozer, which has a drill that the player can rotate in both directions to fight enemies, drill into certain surfaces, and screw objects.
info.why: Nintendo released it in February 2006, after the DS had taken over, and the rumble cartridge has never been re-released physically.
